Captured on macOS on 2026-10-11 with grok 1.0.50 (c58f321264ba) [stable].

Ran grok in a throwaway HOME on a dedicated TMUX_TMPDIR, 100 columns by 35
rows, using the existing Grok authentication and configuration.

Raw captures (no escape preservation or whitespace normalization):
  tmux capture-pane -p -t <session>

finished-wrapped-prompt.txt: a prompt long enough to wrap onto a second row,
  answered, with LANG=en_US.UTF-8.
finished-de-locale.txt: a one-row prompt, answered, with LANG and LC_ALL set
  to de_DE.UTF-8. The clock beside the prompt still reads "3:47 PM".
minimal-two-prompts.txt: grok --minimal, two prompts answered in turn, the
  first long enough to wrap. Prompts sit at the left edge with no clock.
